ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy with moisture, forming a loose mound about 12 cm across and 2 cm tall, with flat broad leaves and thin pale stems; covers roughly 35% of the plate | 90
ITEM 2 | Thin julienned orange strips, about 5-8 cm long and 2-3 mm thick, matte with slight sheen, scattered over and among the greens on the left and right sides; covers roughly 10% of the plate | 35
ITEM 3 | Glossy dressing or moisture sheen on the greens and carrot strips, faint oily film, no distinct pooled liquid visible on the white plate | 5
